question: Does the already frozen HMT Eq.104 + Z7 carrier interface uniquely determine a same-action FLRW carrier background and finite-k quadratic scalar response, so that comparison to the previously certified RTK pole/residue/remainder can be performed without introducing post-hoc completion data?

frozen_candidate.gravity: HMT 2010 Eq.104, projectable local U1, lambda=1
frozen_candidate.carrier_interface: Phi=u1*phi+u2*chi with Z7 internal-null symmetry, gravity-U1-neutral phi/chi, DperpPhi built from invariant shift

required_same_action_inputs_for_match_re: full local carrier potential U(Phi) or equivalent action-level background function
background solution Phi_bar(t) or equations plus boundary data selecting it
action-derived matter/source coupling fixing the scalar response numerator
all carrier couplings to HMT nondynamical A/prepotential fields if nonzero

identifiability_test.background: show whether U'(Phi_bar) and the background trajectory are fixed by the frozen candidate
identifiability_test.quadratic: show whether U''(Phi_bar), spatial-gradient coefficient, and source direction are fixed
identifiability_test.constructive_witness: if not fixed, exhibit two completions compatible with Z11 but with different finite-k inverse response D(omega,k) and/or different background equation

decision_rule: MATCH_READY is allowed only if every required same-action input is already source-locked before this gate. If at least one is absent and two compatible completions give inequivalent background/quadratic response, classify UNDERSPECIFIED_BLOCKED. Do not select missing functions or coefficients from the old RTK pole/residue/remainder or soft-s observable.
required_guards: no new U(Phi), gradient coefficient, matter coupling, HMT auxiliary coupling, or background trajectory is fitted in this gate
